meta.name: product-launch-video
meta.description: Turn a product or marketing URL, pasted script, or brief into a product launch / promo video — SaaS promos, feature reveals, product demos, app and company launches. Use when the user wants to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product; the default for any commercial URL. Site tours / showcases of a website route here too — the brief carries the show-it-as-is intent. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把产品链接或一段草稿变成可直接发布的宣传视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手上只有产品链接或卖点草稿,却急需一支能直接发出去的宣传片。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a product link or rough brief into a ready-to-publish promo video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if all you have is a product link or rough notes and you need a launch video now.

howto.what: 把产品网址、粘贴的脚本或一段简报,变成产品发布/宣传视频(SaaS 推广、功能揭晓、产品演示、App 与公司发布等),在 videos/<项目>/ 里逐步产出分镜、脚本和逐帧画面,最后渲染成 renders/video.mp4。
howto.when: 当你想营销、发布、推广或揭晓某个产品,或给出一条商业网址时触发;网站导览/展示也归这里。意图不明时会先读 /hyperframes 判定路由。

say.text: 用我们官网 https://acme.com 做一支产品发布视频
say.note: 先抓取网站,再规划分镜和脚本

say.text: 把这段产品脚本做成宣传片:<粘贴脚本>
say.note: 旁白按 BRIEF.md 里的 VO_MODE 处理

say.text: 给这个新功能做一支 30 秒的揭晓视频
say.note: 成片时长取自简报里的 length

howto.what_en: Turns a product URL, pasted script, or brief into a launch/promo video — SaaS promos, feature reveals, demos, app and company launches — producing storyboard, script and frames, then renders/video.mp4 in videos/<project>/.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product, or give a commercial URL; site tours and showcases route here too. Unclear intent reads /hyperframes first.

say_en.text: Make a product launch video from our site https://acme.com
say_en.note: It captures the site, then plans storyboard and script

say_en.text: Turn this product script into a promo: <paste script>
Make a 30-second reveal video for this new feature
say_en.note: Duration comes from the brief's length
